title: My Boss Accidentally Hit Reply-All: “Fire the New Guy.” I Was the New Guy.
hook: My boss hit reply-all: "Fire the new guy Friday." I'm the new guy.
story: My boss accidentally hit reply-all on an email meant for HR. It said: "Fire the new guy on Friday. Make it look like performance." I was the new guy. The whole office saw it. My boss went bright red. So I hit reply-all too, and wrote: "No problem. Before Friday, I'll finish the client report you asked for." Then I did something nobody expected. I actually finished it. The best report I've ever written. And I copied the client, like he'd told me to on Monday. On Thursday, the client called. Not my boss. The CEO. They said it was the best work they'd ever gotten from our company, and they'd only renew the contract if the new guy stayed on their account. Friday came. Someone got fired. It wasn't me. Turns out the CEO had read the reply-all too, and wanted to know why a manager was planning to fire the one person his biggest client loved. So now I have his old office. And I still read every email twice… before I hit reply-all.
description:
Never hit reply-all angry. 📧
